extracted.intended_audience: public relations and investor relations professionals; companies and organizations submitting press releases
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and service-related standards for preparing, targeting, filing, distributing, and measuring corporate press releases and related multimedia for broad and targeted media/audience reach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transmit full-text news releases and multimedia
rubrics_metrics.description: Business Wire transmits full-text news releases, regulatory filings, photos and other multimedia content to journalists, financial professionals, investor services, regulatory authorities and the general public worldwide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include full-text of the release and any relevant multimedia (photos, video) when submitting so the wire can deliver complete content to journalists, financial services and the public.

rubrics_metrics.name: Satisfy regulatory disclosure obligations (EDGAR/SEDAR/European filings)
rubrics_metrics.description: Business Wire offers services for satisfying regulatory obligations in the US and around the globe. Our in-house EDGAR team ... makes Business Wire the largest EDGAR filer in the newswire sector. Business Wire also offers Canadian SEDAR and UK Regulatory filings, along with disclosure fulfillment in Belgium, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Ireland, the Netherlands, Luxembourg, Sweden and Switzerland.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When the release constitutes material/regulatory disclosure, use the appropriate filing service (EDGAR, SEDAR, UK/European disclosure services) to meet compliance and disclosure requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use industry-segment targeting (Pinpoint News Delivery)
rubrics_metrics.description: In the US, our Business Wire, AutomotiveWire, EntertainmentWire, HealthWire and SportsWire networks offer more than 200 industry segments to provide highly targeted news delivery to relevant audiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select the most relevant industry segment(s) when distributing so your release reaches the journalists and outlets that cover that sector; finer targeting increases relevance and pickup.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use issue-specific circuits for topical distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Business Wire provides services for issue-specific news such as corporate social responsibility and public policy with our CSR Circuit and Public Policy Circuits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For topic-driven news (e.g., CSR or public policy), route releases through the appropriate issue circuit to reach specialized media and stakeholders interested in those issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target demographic markets
rubrics_metrics.description: Demographic markets include Hispanic, African and Asian American.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When audience demographics are important, specify demographic-targeted distribution to reach ethnic or community-focused media and audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure full-text carriage with leading news organizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Business Wire is the only commercial newswire that has full-text carriage provisions with all of the world's leading news organizations: Agence France-Presse, Associated Press, Bloomberg, Dow Jones and ThomsonReuters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use a distribution service that secures full-text carriage with major news organizations to maximize the chance of complete, accurate pickup by major outlets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leverage Smart News Release for multimedia distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Via Business Wire's exclusive Smart News Release platform, text news releases and multimedia content are posted online and distributed to key audiences via the Business Wire network. Photo Smart News Releases are posted directly to Yahoo! Finance, distributed to daily newspapers in the US via the Associated Press photo network and posted to community and industry-based websites.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Smart News Release / Photo Smart News Release formats to ensure photos and multimedia are distributed to specialized channels (e.g., Yahoo! Finance, AP photo network) and posted online in optimized formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: International photo/multimedia distribution via agency partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: Smart News Release also offers photo distribution to newspapers and media in the UK, Europe and Asia via leading photo agency partnerships.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For international multimedia reach, use the wire's agency partnership options to get images and multimedia into regional photo networks and media outlets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Measure and analyze release performance (NewsTrak)
rubrics_metrics.description: Business Wire's suite of measurement and monitoring services, NewsTrak, provides news release distribution statistics, website posting reports, online viewership data, media clips, media intelligence, reputation management and analytics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track distribution statistics, viewership, media clips and analytics post-distribution to evaluate impact and refine targeting, messaging and multimedia usage for future releases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use tradeshow and conference partnerships for additional exposure
rubrics_metrics.description: Our tradeshow and conference division ... providing integrated communications tools ... by working with leading industry shows and financial conferences, including having Official Wire status at dozens of them, we provide unique additional exposure for our members' news.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coordinate press release distribution with relevant tradeshows and conferences (using 'Official Wire' channels) to gain event-specific visibility and reach attendees and industry press.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prioritize personalized local newsroom support, fast turnaround, and accuracy
rubrics_metrics.description: Business Wire continues to be a proponent of personalized customer service. With more newsrooms than any other commercial newswire, Business Wire provides better local support with fast turnaround of your news releases and greater accuracy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose distribution partners that provide local newsroom support, quick turnaround and accuracy to ensure releases are localized correctly and distributed promptly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Optimize press releases for SEO and follow writing/submission guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Site features include 'How to Write a Press Release', 'How to Submit a Press Release', 'SEO Tips', and 'Press Release Optimization'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow recommended writing and submission best practices and apply SEO optimization techniques (headlines, keywords, links, multimedia metadata) to improve online findability and pickup.
